CustomField.description: Entity/Site qualification gate used by Qualification_Criteria_Gate_CC and LeadStageTransitionService_CC. Entity: Industry, Industry Sub-Sector and any two of Annual Revenue, Estimated Annual Spend, Number of Locations, Pallet Volume. Site: Estimated Annual Spend or Pallet Volume.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Type_CC__c, "Entity"), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Industry))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Industry_Sub_Sector_CC__c))), IF(ISBLANK(AnnualRevenue), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(Estimated_Annual_Spend_CC__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(Number_of_Locations_CC__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Pallet_Volume_Factor__c)), 0, 1) >= 2 ), IF( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Type_CC__c, "Site"), IF(ISBLANK(Estimated_Annual_Spend_CC__c), 0, 1) + IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Pallet_Volume_Factor__c)), 0, 1) >= 1, FALSE ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the qualification questions for this Lead Type are complete. Entity: Industry, Industry Sub-Sector and any two of the four metrics. Site: Estimated Annual Spend or Pallet Volume.
CustomField.label: Qualification Criteria Met
